dedupe_keys.name: fireurisk european canopy fuel load and canopy bulk density maps at 1 km e cienciadatos

description: This dataset maps two descriptors of crown fire behaviour, canopy fuel load and canopy bulk density, across the European forest territory at 1 km resolution, produced within the FirEUrisk project and deposited on the e-cienciaDatos repository in January 2025. Leaf area density was estimated from GEDI spaceborne lidar footprints and converted into the two parameters, then extrapolated to areas without GEDI coverage with machine learning models using Landsat 8 multispectral imagery, PALSAR L-band radar and biophysical variables for vegetation, climate and terrain. The deposit holds four GeoTIFF maps, the two parameters and their pixel-level uncertainties, with a readme, and is free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. The method is described in a 2025 Remote Sensing of Environment article. Caveats: values are modelled estimates with stated uncertainty, the 1 km grid is coarse for local fire spread, and the maps represent conditions around the GEDI observation period. Simulation uses: parameterising crown fire spread and wildfire hazard models used to plan fire service resources, estimating emissions, and assessing wildfire exposure of infrastructure in Europe. Related records: the NASA FIRMS active fire data (data-nasa-firms-active-fire) give observed fire detections for validation.
